emiliania_huxleyi_coccolith_specimen.species: Emiliania huxleyi (Haptophyta: Noelaerhabdaceae) dual-panel Scanning Electron Micrograph (SEM): left panel shows an intact interlocking spherical coccosphere (10,000x, 2 um scale bar); right panel shows an isolated heterococcolith rosette shield with radial T-shaped hammer-head distal elements and central tube (20,000x, 1 um scale bar)

governing_equations.section: Young et al. (1992) Nature 356:516-518; Didymus et al. (1993) Proc. R. Soc. B 252:259-264; Jaya et al. (2016) Nat. Commun. 7:11904

vr_bimodal_nucleation_ring.angular_lattice: theta_k = 2*pi*k / N_seg for k = 0, ..., N_seg - 1; total alternating proto-coccolith nuclei N_total = 2 * N_seg (N_V = N_seg vertical V-units, N_R = N_seg radial R-units)
vr_bimodal_nucleation_ring.c_axis_orientations: c_V = (0, 0, 1) normal to organic baseplate plane; c_R(theta_k) = (cos(theta_k), sin(theta_k), 0) radial along baseplate rim => c_V . c_R(theta_k) = 0 (exact 90 deg crystallographic orthogonality)
vr_bimodal_nucleation_ring.r_unit_dominance: In Emiliania huxleyi (Noelaerhabdaceae), R-units outgrow vestigial V-units (V_R / V_V >= 15) to form all distal and proximal shield elements, central tube, and inner grid

linear_proto_coccolith_scaling_law.tube_radius: R_tube(N_seg) = (N_seg * w_0) / (2 * pi), where w_0 = 0.145 um is the conserved R/V crystal pair nucleation pitch along the baseplate rim
linear_proto_coccolith_scaling_law.distal_shield_length: L_d(N_seg) = 2 * (R_tube(N_seg) + L_spoke) = (N_seg * w_0) / pi + 2 * L_spoke, where L_spoke = 1.011 um is the radial spoke extension
linear_proto_coccolith_scaling_law.elliptical_rim_locus: x(theta) = a_d * cos(theta), y(theta) = b_d * sin(theta), with b_d / a_d = 0.8478 and eccentricity e = sqrt(1 - (b_d/a_d)^2) = 0.5303

hammer_spoke_and_coccosphere_mechanics.t_head_hammer_width: w_head(r, Omega_calcite, c_CAP) = w_spoke * (1 + alpha_T * S_CAP(r) * tanh(max(Omega_calcite - 1.0, 0.0))), where coccolith-associated polysaccharides (CAPs) selectively inhibit acute {10-14} lateral faces along the spoke shaft while releasing tangential growth at the outer rim to form interlocking T-heads
hammer_spoke_and_coccosphere_mechanics.suture_imbrication: theta_suture(r) = theta_k + psi_imb * ((r - R_tube) / L_spoke), with chiral clockwise distal suture imbrication angle psi_imb = 18.0 deg
hammer_spoke_and_coccosphere_mechanics.spherical_euler_packing: V - E + F = 2 on S^2; for trivalent coccolith contact graph (3*V = 2*E), V = 2*(F - 2) and E = 3*(F - 2) for F = N_cocc interlocking coccoliths
hammer_spoke_and_coccosphere_mechanics.coccosphere_buckling_load: F_buckling(N_cocc, delta_overlap) = C_shell * E_calcite * (h_shield / R_sphere)^2 * (1 + beta_lock * delta_overlap) (Jaya et al. 2016 interlocking load transfer)

morphospace_regimes.section: Young et al. (1992) Nature 356:516-518, Didymus et al. (1993) Proc. R. Soc. B 252:259-264 & Jaya et al. (2016) Nat. Commun. 7:11904

regimes.label: Morphotype A Canonical Interlocking Rosette (N_seg=32, Omega=4.2, T-head Hammer Ratio=1.72, Curved Chiral Sutures)
Morphotype B Large Delicate Shield (N_seg=38, Omega=3.8, Long Spokes L_d=4.31 um, Wide Slits)
Morphotype C Small Subpolar Shield (N_seg=26, Omega=3.5, Compact Rim L_d=2.85 um, N_cocc=18)
Morphotype R Reticulofenestra-like Overcalcified Shield (N_seg=30, Omega=5.0, Fused Broad Spokes, Slit Fraction -> 0.04)
Ocean Acidification & CAP-Polysaccharide Ablation Control (Omega=0.75 < 1, c_CAP=0 -> T-Head Truncation, Ragged Rim, Loss of Coccosphere Interlock)
